title: Impressive Features But Performs Poorly--Has Inadequate Battery, Suction; Needs Supervision
text:
Impressive Features But Performs Poorly--Has Inadequate Battery, Suction; Needs Supervision. Compared to my [[ASIN:B008LX6OC6 Roomba 650]] (plus [[ASIN:B019OH9898 Braava Jet]]), this ECOVACS DEEBOT M88 ROBOTIC VACUUM CLEANER, DRY AND WET MOP FEATURE WITH SMARTPHONE CONTROL (White) just doesn't cut it. The robot’s Achilles’ heel is the inadequate battery--a full 4-hour charge gives you about 45 minutes, which is NOT enough to finish vacuuming a small, carpeted living room with obstacles (furniture, clutter). Recharging, to complete the job, takes hours.

Standard suction is also inadequate. The robot does NOT pick up larger dirt particles, rice grains, or other gritty bits. To keep a carpet or even a bare floor clean, regular vacuuming with an upright or canister vacuum will still be required. The robot runs slowly, and the random pattern (required for carpet) changes directions so often, it is impossible to get full floor coverage in a single run.

Cleaning the dirt collecter is very complicated--you must open the top, pull up a handle to remove the dirt bin, open a gate to empty the dirt and dust bunnies, and then clean off a thin sponge that protects a high-efficiency filter. (I had to retrieve the sponge from the trash, after I inadvertently dumped it along with the collected dirt.) Then you have to reverse the steps to replace the bin.

The robot requires quite a bit of supervision when working. It has a sloped top edge that causes it to get stuck easily under low furniture or obstacles. It does NOT climb over flat area rugs, or easily move from bare floor to carpet. (The instructions say you should use physical barriers, and vacuum carpeted and bare floors separately.) The sensors could be a lot better--the robot spends a lot of time thinking about what to do after meeting an obstacle, and it isn't very good at detecting stairsteps or “cliffs”.

When the battery needs recharging, the robot slows to a pathetic crawl. It may not have enough power left to find its way back to the recharging station. Placing the robot on the charger by hand is fiddly, and the robot is easily jarred off the charger contacts. The robot has an inconveniently placed on/off switch underneath--and you have to turn the robot off if you want it to hold a charge away from the charger.

The robot has three cleaning patterns--random, back and forth, and around the edges of the room. The default pattern is random, and you must use the remote (included) or the app to change the pattern. My remote changed the robot to the “edge” pattern, but would NOT change the pattern to “back and forth” (the pattern recommended for bare floors, that I really needed for cleaning under a queen-sized bed).

When it comes to wet-mopping, this robot is too large to mop my bathrooms. It can't get into the small spaces alongside the toilets, and the round shape means it can't mop close to the room edges or under the cabinet overhangs.

In sum, this Eurovac robot is unsuitable for regularly cleaning rooms that have a fair amount of furniture or clutter, or for wet mopping rooms with tight spaces. Because my iRobot devices do both tasks easily, I think that this Eurovac device is very expensive (about $450 on Amazon) for what it is. I wanted a second robot vacuum for convenience in cleaning the upstairs, and was impressed by all of this robot’s advertised features (especially the included remote), but I’m very, very disappointed by the Eurovac robot’s actual performance.

features: Dust bin capacity 380 milliliter; Effective 5 stage cleaning process features an optional advanced mopping system to sweep, lift, vacuum, mop and dry in a single pass
Includes 2 interchangeable suction options; Main brush for deep cleaning or direct suction for vacuuming pet and human hair; Includes a Max mode for deeper cleaning
Stair safety, obstacle detection, auto charging; Schedule daily or weekly cleanings directly from your phone

Combines smart move technology, which simulates a human cleaning pattern (for hardwood floors) and smart motion technology (for carpet) which ensures persistent debris is removed to provide exceptional cleaning (setting can be changed in app)

description: Our M88 has a ruthless focus on dirt and grime. Like all DEEBOTs it can clean every room in your house, but its claim to fame is tackling the hardest working parts of your house. With Smart Move technology that creates a more focused cleaning pattern, and our unique Single Room setting, the M88 will dry mop and clean the most stubborn of rooms. Features working time approximately 90 minutes  and also features dust bin capacity of 380 milliliters with charging time of approximately 4 to 5 hours.
